verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Alacritty's source is publicly hosted on GitHub and can be built with `cargo build --release`, so users can read the source. However, nothing in the pack names the license or confirms it is an open license. missing for 10: explicit open-source license identification (e.g. a LICENSE file or SPDX terms), independent corroboration of licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The supported platforms currently consist of BSD, Linux, macOS and Windows.
